title: Keyboard navigation — all interactive elements reachable by keyboard
objective: Verify that all interactive elements in governed surfaces are reachable and operable via keyboard alone, without requiring mouse interaction. Based on WCAG 2.2 2.1.1 Keyboard.

source.description: Visual contract surfaces must be keyboard accessible — add-ons inheriting the design system inherit accessibility requirements

execution.criteria: Tab through all interactive elements: navigation items, buttons, links, form inputs, cards, status indicators. Each must receive visible focus and be activatable with Enter/Space.
execution.expected_outcome: All interactive elements reachable via sequential keyboard navigation

evidence_required: Tab order includes sidebar nav items

pass_criteria.description: Visible focus indicator on every interactive element
evidence_required: Focus ring or outline visible on tab stop
